# slackapi

A client to interact with the [Slack Web
API](https://api.slack.com/web). The Slack Web API is an interface for
querying information *from* and enacting change *in* a Slack workspace.

## Installation

You can install the development version of {slackapi} from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("jonthegeek/slackapi")
```

## Made with {beekeeper}

This package is being developed using the
[{beekeeper}](https://beekeeper.api2r.org/) package. Development is very
active, and this package will likely change a lot in the coming weeks.

## Code of Conduct

Please note that the slackapi project is released with a [Contributor
Code of
Conduct](https://jonthegeek.github.io/slackapi/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html). By
contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`conversations_history()`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/slackapi/reference/conversations_history.md)
  [`req_conversations_history()`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/slackapi/reference/conversations_history.md)
  : Get conversations history
- [`conversations_list()`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/slackapi/reference/conversations_list.md)
  [`req_conversations_list()`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/slackapi/reference/conversations_list.md)
  : Get conversations list
- [`conversations_replies()`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/slackapi/reference/conversations_replies.md)
  [`req_conversations_replies()`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/slackapi/reference/conversations_replies.md)
  : Get conversations replies
- [`users_list()`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/slackapi/reference/users_list.md)
  [`req_users_list()`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/slackapi/reference/users_list.md)
  : Get users list
